# Are your GitHub Actions pinned to a commit SHA?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every third-party action referenced by a mutable tag like @v4 instead of a pinned 40-character commit SHA. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
